Commentary.Commentary: This ends our first knockout game. In the end, both the sides had tears in their eyes, one for a happy reason, other for a sad one. It is curtains for South Africa while hosts England become the first team through to the finals. To find out who join them at Lord's we shift our attention to another thrilling encounter hopefully, the second semi-finals - Australia vs India at Derby on 20th July. The action begins at 1030 local (0930 GMT). Join us for it. Till then, it's goodbye from us. Take care! Cheers!

South Africa skipper, Dane van Niekerk thinks they were 30 short but knowing her team, she believed and is proud of what they produced. Informs that you always have to believe in the game of cricket. Mentions that as wickets fell, it was getting very close and with their bowling attack anything could happen. She hopes that her team made everyone proud. Says that they needed some magic but it didn't happen today. Ends by saying that they have had a great run and proved many people wrong.

Victorious England skipper, Heather Knight, admits that it was tough seeing such a tight game from the balcony and praises Jenny Gunn for holding her nerve. Thanks the crowd for coming in large numbers. Credits South Africa for the way they came back strongly. Feels that televising women's cricket perhaps puts a little bit of extra pressure on the players but also feels great that so many people are now watching women's cricket. Admits that she did feel nervous when the game went down to the wire but at the same time, trusted her players to bail the team out.

Player of the Match, Sarah Taylor says that it's been a long journey for them and it was too tensed. Mentions that it wasn't much of an enjoyable experience but she knew that they had depth in their batting. In the end it was a fabulous shot from Anya Shrubsole to get us through and also praises the Wilson-Gunn stand under pressure. Applauds South Africa's efforts, saying they fought hard, it's heart-breaking and that she has been on that side as well. Adds that the crowd has been fantastic and thanks them.

Had England won this game by 7 or 6 wickets, the Proteas would not have felt so heartbroken. But because they fought back so well, the feelings would have erupted. It was by no means their best bowling performance with most of their bowlers going for plenty. Skipper van Niekerk could not take a single wicket today and that hurt them. Sune Luus picked up 2 wickets but their best bowler was birthday girl Ayabonga Khaka, who finished with 2/28 in 10 overs. The main difference lied in the extras column. England conceded only 4 wides while South Africa conceded a total of 25 extras - way too many. The keeping of Trisha Chetty was extremely poor and she played a huge role in the swelling of the wides to 17, conceding way too many byes. Stay tuned for the presentation.

England were going at a terrific rate, chasing 219 but they slipped from 139/2 to 145/5. The Women In Green were truly back but not due to good deliveries but some pure luck, getting wickets off poor balls. The home side then got its lower middle order to stand up, with Wilson, Brunt and Gunn fighting it out, as they did against Australia. They messed it up in the end but managed to cross the line.

To be honest, England were in control of the game till that run out of Sarah Taylor. The hosts had lost two quick wickets before that but the 78-run stand for the third wicket had nearly sealed the game. But had it? The Proteas had other ideas.

All of a sudden, the crowd has burst to life. But spare a thought for the Proteas. They have fallen short again. Never have they made it to the final of a Women's World Cup and today is no different. But today they fought really hard, making their country proud. Dane Van Niekerk is on her haunches, in tears and so is Shabnim Ismail and a few other players. Now they get into a huddle. England meanwhile, are celebrating their entry into the final.

FOUR! ENGLAND ARE IN THE FINALS! What a cracking shot to end the game. Throughout the match, we saw other batters struggle to get the ball through that gap between cover and point but no such issues for Shrubsole. She sees a length ball outside off which is slightly wide and crashes it through that gap for a boundary! Shrubsole is pumped up and runs across to hug Gunn. The English camp is all ecstatic. What a match we have had!
ANYA SHRUBSOLE walks out at number 10, replacing Marsh. Does she have the nerves to see this out?

OUT! BOWLED! Excellent change of pace! What a time to bowl this. Ismail roars. The crowd is silenced. A length ball, in line of the stumps, Marsh is through her pull shot months before the ball reaches her and misses it! The ball hits the timber and South Africa breathe again. 2 RUNS NEEDED, 3 BALLS REMAINING AND 2 WICKETS IN HAND.
Comes down the track and eases it through the covers for a single. 2 NEEDED FROM 4 NOW.
DROPPED! Tough chance. A sharp one. Full and outside off, Gunn blasts it straight back. Ismail tries to save herself more than go for the catch, which is understandable and puts it down.
SHABNIM ISMAIL will bowl the final over. Can she spring a surprise? The England camp pretends to be dancing to the DJ's tunes. Bet they will be nervous till this match ends.

STREAKY! Very full outside off, Gunn looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It runs fine past the keeper. The third man fielder is quick to get across and keeps it down to a single. ENGLAND NEED 3 OFF 6 DELIVERIES! Who would have thought that this game would go down to the wire!
Full outside off, driven to covers.
LUCKY! Pitched outside off, Marsh goes for the drive, gets an outside edge. It runs down to third man and a single results.
On a length outside off, tapped to point.
Full outside off, driven to mid off. The fielder there slips and concedes a single.
Full outside off, squeezed to point.
MOSELINE DANIELS gets a change of ends as well.
LAURA MARSH walks in at number 9, replacing Wilson.

OUT! CHETTY FINALLY HOLDS ONTO A CATCH! Wilson trying to be too cheeky, pays the price. Gets across and looks to scoop it over the keeper's head. Doesn't have the pace to do so and the ball lobs over the keeper, who jumps full stretch, extends her right arm and grabs the ball. End of a 40-run stand off just 34 balls. What a crucial stand it has been for England! Can there be any more twists?
Full and angling in, driven through mid on for a single.
Angling into the batsman, Jenny looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Wilson guides it square of the wicket and collects another quick single.
Angling into the batsman, pushed to mid on for a quick single.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed behind point for a quick single.
MARIZANNE KAPP replaces Daniels.
Yorker outside off, dug out on the off side.
FOUR! In the gap again! Low full toss around off. Gunn has a good reach and she drags her pull over mid-wicket for a boundary. England have now got everything in control, thanks to Gunn's cameo.
Full outside off, Gunn fails to dig it out.
FOUR! TONKED! Ismail bowls a cutter on a length. Gunn guns it over the bowler's head to the long on fence. She picked the variation early. Equation is down to 14 off 21!
Pitched outside off, Gunn has a swing at it but misses.

Full outside off, pushed to mid off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. There's no one backing up and the batsmen run for an overthrow. The fielder at fine leg collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the striker's end. The umpire goes upstairs and the replays show Gunn to be fine. Two vital runs added to the total.
SHABNIM ISMAIL is back on.
Angling across Wilson, dabbed to point. 20 needed off 24 balls!

FOUR! In the air for a moment! Full and angling away, carve through point. Lee dives to her left but the ball bounces ahead of her and sneaks through the gap to the fence behind. That will do really good for England.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wilson comes ahead, plays with soft hands on the off side and takes a quick single.
A touch ahead of a length around off, lofted on the bounce to wide long on for a single.
Fuller around leg, worked off the inner half on the leg side for a single.
Yorker outside off, Gunn fails to squeeze it.
Full outside off, steered to backward point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Wide! Length delivery wide outside off, Gunn leaves it and gets a wide again. In trying to stay out of the batsman's arc, Kapp is overdoing it and has been bowling wides.
Wide! Wide yorker. Gunn leaves it alone. The umpire spreads his arms to signal a wide. Very close call that!

Bye! Another fumble from Chetty! This is not acceptable at all. A superb yorker outside off. Wilson fails to dig it out. Chetty, who is having a horrid time out in the middle, makes another mistake and concedes another extra. Kapp and van Niekerk don't look impressed at all, why would they?
Full outside off, driven nicely through covers for a single.

FOUR! BOUNDARY OFF THE FIRST BALL! What a way to start the over! Pressure back on the bowling side. A length delivery outside off, whipped through the gap between mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary. Gunn has produced some vital knocks earlier and her team needs one today.
MARIZANNE KAPP gets a change of ends.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to point. 36 NEEDED OFF 36!

FOUR! TOP SHOT! And under pressure it was even more excellent. A length delivery outside off, Wilson predetermines to scoop it. Adjusts according to the line and reverse scoops it over the keeper and to the third man fence. With this, fine leg drops back.
Back of a length delivery outside off, chopped to extra cover again. Another dot, pressure is building!

Fullish delivery outside off, Wilson takes a couple of steps ahead and drives it on the off side. Van Niekerk at short extra cover dives across and makes another superb stop. She's leading from the front, setting a great example for others.
Wide outside off, Gunn uses the pace on offer and glides it off the outer half to third man for a single.
On a fuller length outside off, Wilson turns it towards wide mid on and collects a single.
SHABNIM ISMAIL is brought back on.
On the pads, clipped towards fine leg for a brace.
Full around off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Full around leg, flicked through wide mid on. Ismail there misfields and concedes a couple.
Slanting away from Gunn, pushed to covers.
JENNY GUNN walks in at number 8, replacing Brunt. Gunn played a useful hand lower down the order against Australia. Does she have the nerves to do the same in a semi-final?

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! South Africa are roaring at the moment. Katherine Brunt who was seen advancing down the track a couple of times in the previous over does it once again. However, this time it's the angle from the left-armer which does her in. She fails to flick it away and the ball deflects off the pads to shatter the woodwork. The equation is now down to run-a-ball. 46 needed off 46! What a game we have one our hands, truly enticing!
Slanting away from the batsman, guided to third man for a single.
MOSELINE DANIELS now comes from the skipper's end. Bowling changes galore.
ANOTHER FUMBLE BY CHETTY! On a length outside off, Wilson looks to cut but ends up chopping it over the keeper's head. It's an easy take for Trisha but once again she fumbles and concedes a run.
Length delivery outside off, chopped to point.
Full toss around off, Brunt mistimes her loft to long off for a single.
Once again Brunt dances down and only manages to dig it out to van Niekerk at extra cover.
Full around off, Brunt dances down the track and cover drives. Van Niekerk at extra cover, dives to her right and makes an excellent stop.
Very full, tailing into the boots. Brunt looks to squeeze it out but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
MARIZANNE KAPP comes back on. Van Niekerk is changing her bowlers every now and then as she does not want the batters to get used to one particular pair.
Brunt this time finds the gap in covers with her punch. She will retain the strike with this single.
Another delivery on the shorter side, Katherine goes back to cut but fails to make any connection.
Leg spinner around off, Brunt goes back and punches it to covers.
Brunt prods forward and blocks it down the track and looks for a run but is sent back by Wilson immediately.
Another leg spinner on the shorter side. It's wide as well and Brunt goes back and punches it through covers. Gets in the gap there and collects a brace.
Starts with a shortish leg spinner outside off, Wilson stays back and cuts it through point for a single.

19/0 in the Batting Powerplay. South Africa made 22/0 in theirs. The Proteas were 157/4 at this stage, so nothing much to choose between the teams. Crucial moment here. The captain takes the ball. DANE VAN NIEKERK comes on to bowl again.
Jumps down the track and drives it straight to short extra cover. There is a fumble but no harm done.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Wilson misses her flick and wears it on the pads.

Comes down the track and this time drives it through the covers for a single. The stand moves to 20 from 33 balls. Nowhere as fast as Brunt is normally used to, but right now, England  need wickets in hand. The required run rate has slightly jumped up, so they need to look at that sooner or later.
Comes down the track, yorks herself and ends up pushing it back to Daniels.
Full on middle and leg, watchfully defended.
Dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and steers it through the covers and gets a single.
Full and wide outside off, driven straight to point.
Fractionally short outside off, cut behind point for a single. Third man is a bit squarer as opposed to earlier.
Excellent delivery, a yorker on off, almost gets through but Wilson manages to get her bat down in time.
Full and wide outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, Brunt dances down the track and drives it straight to short extra cover.
Very full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Very full outside off, Wilson steers this towards backward point and yells clearly and loudly, "WAIT! WAIT!"
Full and wide again, action replay of the previous ball. Another single.
Similar ball, this is driven well past Lee through the covers for one. 59 more needed from 75 balls now.
Outside off, a full toss, driven towards cover for a quick run. Lizelle Lee quickly gets across to her right from point but fumbles and allows the run easily.
Full and wide outside off, angling away, pushed through the covers for a single.
MOSELINE DANIELS is back on.
A lovely wide yorker outside off, Brunt cannot put bat on ball.
On a good length outside off, angling in, watchfully defended towards cover.
Full and wide outside off, driven straight to backward point.
Short again, cut hard through point where Lizelle Lee dives to her left and half-stops the ball. Just a single. Wilson moves to 10 from 13 balls.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and straight, watchfully blocked.
Down the leg side, swept to fine leg for one more.
Tossed up outside leg, pushed towards mid-wicket for one. The stand moves to 10 from 11 balls.
A poor ball again, a full toss down the leg side, swept to fine leg for a run.

FOUR! That is a very good shot. Landed outside off, Wilson brings out the reverse sweep and beats a racing Mignon du Preez with a fully committed dive from short third man! 150 UP FOR ENGLAND. 66 more needed from 87 balls now.
Very full, around off, swept straight to square leg.
Shorter in length, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE. Another trash. Way down the leg side, Brunt looks to pull but misses. Trisha Chetty fumbles again but this time does not concede anything.
Batting Powerplay signalled! Three fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle. Who will benefit from this? Let's see. Sune Luus to continue...
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and wide outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Waits for this one to come to her, still goes after it, yet does not time it, slashing her run-down-to-third man-attempt and earning a single off the outside edge.
Outside off, left alone.
Short and outside off, Wilson looks to cut but chops it into the ground over the leaping keeper to third man. A single taken.
KATHERINE BRUNT walks out to bat. The pressure is back on England now. Meanwhile, DRINKS was taken. Can England use this break to calms things down?

OUT! Bowled around her legs! Luus has spun this game around from nowhere. England have collapsed very badly. 6/3 in 2 overs. This is a good ball though. Luus tosses this up outside leg and Sciver looks to paddle it fine. She misses and the ball spins in, past the bat and hits the stumps! She was trying a similar dismissal against Taylor and Knight but they were playing her well. We have a game on now. ENGLAND NEED 74 FROM 96 BALLS BUT 5 WICKETS ARE LEFT.
Full and down the leg side, swept fine for one.
Pushes this through mid on for a run.
Outside off, punches this wide of mid off for a single.
FRAN WILSON strides out to bat. Out of nowhere, the Proteas have bounced back and England now have two new batsmen out in the middle.

OUT! Poor ball but a fantastic catch! Is the game turning? Both set batters out in the space of 8 legal balls! One can't help but smile looking at the Proteas. This is a very poor ball, a full toss on middle and leg and Knight is ready for it. Pulls or rather swats it over square leg but Laura Wolvaardt times her leap to perfection and takes it! The umpires get together for a chat to discuss the no ball for height and she is made to wait but then sent on her way after replays confirm it to be legal ball. 77 MORE NEEDED FROM 100 BALLS.
Full on middle, clipped straight to short mid-wicket.
WIDE. A rubbish ball to start, full and wide outside off, spinning further away, well past the guideline, left alone.
SUNE LUUS comes back on.

Full on off, Sciver walks across and somehow dabs it between her legs through square leg, a shot which only she plays. Two runs taken. That is called the Natmeg shot. 78 more needed from 102 balls now.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Around off, watchfully defended towards cover.
NATALIE SCIVER is the new woman in.

OUT! Van Niekerk scores a bull's eye! Is that the break South Africa needed? A wicket against the run of play? Who knows! Could be. Excellent piece of fielding from the South African captain. Full and outside off, Knight pushed it towards cover and set off for a single. Dane van Niekerk quickly got to her left, took aim and then threw it at the striker's end, hitting the stumps. There was an appeal made but interestingly, the captain was not too confident, shaking her head. However, replays showed Taylor to be short! It is now her turn to shake her head as she walks off. End of a good knock which was turning into a match-winning one, as she was threatening to take the game away. Do the Proteas still have a chance? ENGLAND NEED 80 FROM 107 BALLS!
SHABNIM ISMAIL is back on.
FOUR! A delightful shot. Fullish on middle, tailing in slightly, Taylor walks down the track and flicks it past a diving Chloe Tryon at mid on for a boundary. 11 from that over.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
18th ODI Fifty for Sarah Taylor, 3rd against South Africa!
Pushes this through mid on and takes another quick run. A good knock from the keeper-batsman.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off. Knight takes Shabnim Ismail on who misses her direct hit at the non-striker's end but Knight would have been in even if that had hit.

FOUR! Fine shot. Walks down the track, does Knight, takes the ball on the half volley and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. 87 more needed from 113 balls now. This stand is worth 71 from 109 balls.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
And again, Action replay of the previous ball. Another play and a miss.
Very full outside off, Taylor looks to run it to third man but misses.
FOUR! That is some shot. Walks down the track and audaciously sweeps a length ball through mid-wicket. Talk about confidence, she has plenty.
Outside off, eased straight to cover.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Taylor looks to drive it with the angle but gets it off the inner half on the leg side. ENGLAND NEED 96 OFF 120 BALLS!
Angling away from Heather Knight, she drives it nicely through the gap in covers for a single.
Full on off, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Full on middle and leg, Heather drives it off the inner half to mid on.
Slanting away from Knight, driven to covers.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
Wide! Daniels starts her new spell with a wide down the leg side.
DOUBLE CHANGE. MOSELINE DANIELS replaces Luus.
Length delivery wide outside off, Taylor goes for the punch on the off side but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Slightly fuller this time, pushed to covers.
Back of a length delivery outside off, chopped to point.

FOUR! PULLED AWAY! Shortish delivery around off, angling in. Taylor gets in the position early and pulls it hard and flat in front of square on the leg side for a boundary. Less than 100 needed now. Chances of South Africa reaching the finals seem even more slim now.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut to point.

FOUR! INNOVATIVE! Back of a length delivery around off, Taylor gets across and scoops it over the keeper's head. Gets the connection right this time and the ball sails fine down the leg side to the fence.
MARIZANNE KAPP comes back on. South Africa need a wicket or two quickly.
Here's another half-tracker. Knight goes back to hammer it but mistimes it to mid off.
Another long hop from Luus. Taylor pulls it hard over mid-wicket but there's a woman at deep mid-wicket. Only a single results.
Tossed up around leg, Knight sweeps it through backward square leg for a single. The 50-RUN STAND is up.
Shortish delivery outside off, punched down to long on for a single.
Leg spinner around off, keeps a touch low. Taylor keeps it out on the off side.
Loopy delivery down the leg side, swept to long leg for a single.

Back of a length delivery outside off, glided to third man for a single. Ayabonga Khaka bowls her 10 overs on the trot and finishes with - 10-2-28-2! Superb bowling! But her team mates need to back it up now. England have not been hurt too badly by those figures.
Back of a length delivery outside off, cut to backward point this time.
Length delivery outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Fullish delivery around off, driven back to the bowler.
Wide outside off, cut straight to point.
On a length outside off, driven off the inner half to mid on.
Fires it into the boots of the batsman. Milked down to long on for a single.
Leg spinner outside off, spins away a long way. Taylor stays back and looks to pull it away, ends up dragging it towards mid-wicket. Everyone has a laugh seeing that!
Tossed up on middle and leg, swept down to long leg for a single.
Shortish delivery, chopped to point.
Knight now goes for the sweep but finds the player at square leg.
Tossed up down the leg side, Taylor kneels down and sweeps it to long leg for a single.
Once again it's driven through covers for a single. 115 required off 150 balls!
Full and straight around off, driven through covers for a single.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Wide! Wide outside off, Taylor leaves it and gets a wide.
Fuller length delivery around off, driven to mid off.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to covers.

ALMOST A DOUBLE-BOUNCE BALL! Luus lands a leg spinner halfway down the track. Knight waits for it and looks to tonk it but ends up digging it out. Had she left it, she would have got a no ball for double bounce.
Short delivery, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single. 100 up for England!
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Heather kneels down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Long hop from the leggie, Taylor pulls it with disdain over mid-wicket for a single.
SHARP TURN! Leg spinner on middle, spinning away. Taylor is surprised by seeing so much turn, defends it off the inner half down the wicket.
Knight kneels down and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
SUNE LUUS is on. One leg spinner replaces another as skipper van Niekerk takes herself off.

DROPPED! A difficult chance, similar to the one she dropped earlier. Full and wide outside off, Knight looks to drive it on the up. Gets an outside edge and the ball flies to the right of the keeper, who dives, gets a hand to it but fails to grab it in her fingertips. The ball rolls away to third man and a single is taken.
Full outside off, driven through covers.
Slanting down leg, Taylor looks to tickle it down the leg side but misses. The ball brushes the pads and goes to the keeper.
Full an straight on off, driven back to the bowler.
Angling into the batsman, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Taylor comes down a touch and punches it on the up through covers for a single.
Once again Taylor camps back and punches it through covers for a single. 5 runs off the over shows how easily the Englishwomen are allowed to pick up singles.
Loopy delivery around middle and off, swept through square leg for a single.
Slider around off, skids through. Knight chops it to point.
Tossed up outside off, Sarah clears her front leg and punches it through covers again for a single.
A similar delivery and this time Knight punches it through covers for a single.
Leg spinner outside off, Taylor goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Full and angling in, driven to mid on. ANOTHER MAIDEN FROM KHAKA! She's having a superb time out there. She has bowled 31 dot balls in her 7 overs.

Captaincy - Pressure or confidence boost? A good debate which is never ending. But it certainly seems to be the latter for Heather Knight. Before she was made the captain, she averaged close to 32 in ODIs. But with added responsibility, her batting averaged has leaped to around 42 now. Impressive.
Full outside off, sliced to backward point.
Wide outside off, Knight goes after the width on offer. Slashes it in the point region. The ball falls just before Lee, who does well to stop it with her body.
A touch ahead of a length outside off, Heather prods ahead and defends it on the off side.
Full outside off, Knight drives it crisply but finds the fielder at the edge of the ring at covers.
Full and straight on middle, clipped to mid-wicket.

FOUR! That is a bad ball. A high full toss and Taylor is alert to swat it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Things have just slowed down a touch barring that boundary but England looking calm and well in control.
Full on middle, swept through square leg for one.
Full and around off, pushed towards cover.
Tossed up on middle, pushed down to long on for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Shortish on middle, punched away to long on for a single. 139 more needed from 185 balls now.
Full and wide outside off, driven straight to point.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Walks well across her stumps and Khaka bowls it wide outside off. Taylor tries the paddle scoop given that fine leg is a bit square but is not too successful. Does not find the boundary as the fielder gets across. Two runs taken.
Outside off, run down to third man for a single.
Full and straight, driven back to the bowler.

She has been immaculate with her lines and lengths, Khaka. Keeps this outside off, a fraction wide, Knight looks to run it down to third man but misses. We thought there was a noise but Snickometer showed nothing. Anyways, the ball bounced in front of the keeper.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point. Very good over from the captain in spite of that extra ball.
Full and on middle, ST flicks it towards short fine leg. Sets off for a single but is sent back.
Pushes this towards mid on again.
Short and outside off, Sarah looks to cut but gets a bottom edge.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.

WIDE AND TWO BYES. Poor keeping from Chetty again. She is having a horrid time when the ball has been bowled down the leg side. Van Niekerk slips this outside leg, Taylor looks to flick but misses. Chetty fumbles, in fact, does not even gather the ball or touch it and the ball goes through. Short fine leg mops it up and keeps the batters to two.
Landed around middle, punched towards deep cover for a single.

Drinks has been taken! England are in a great position right now and their batsmen just need to keep the strike rotating to get the victory under their belt. South Africa on the other hand need to pick up wickets in bunch to put the pressure on the host nation. A place in finals is at stake. Next period is going to be a crucial one for both the team!
Full and outside off, driven back past the bowler straight to mid off.
Takes the pace off this one, Sarah looks to drive this through the off side but the slowness of the pitch induces an inside edge and the ball goes to mid on.
Good job by the captain. Taylor drives this half volley beautifully through the covers but Dane van Niekerk dives to her left at short extra cover and stops it.
Landed outside off, Knight leans into this one, reaches out, opens the face of her bat and dabs it to third man for a single. The stand moves to 10 from 21 balls.
Full and just outside off, pushed towards cover again.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Outside off, spinning away, played with the turn to short third man for a quick single. 149 more needed from 204 balls now.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated outside off, driven straight to cover.
Stays back in her crease and blocks.

Not a bad ball on the Free Hit, following the batter as she advances down the track, bowls it on middle and leg, cramping her for room and all Taylor can do is flick it to deep mid-wicket for a run. Not too much expensive was that no ball then.
FREE HIT coming up!
NO BALL! That is unpardonable. A spinner overstepping. It is by a big margin too. Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Tossed up outside off, pushed straight to short extra cover.
DANE VAN NIEKERK brings herself on. First signs of spin from the Proteas. She's the highest wicket-taker of the tournament and she needs to add to her tally for her side to make it to the finals.
Outside off, played straight to Lee this time. A MAIDEN!

Short and wide outside off, Sarah cuts it through point but Lizelle Lee, who has just taken off her gloves a few minutes back, gets across quickly to her right to stop the ball. She is doing a similar job to what Fran Wilson did earlier in the day for the hosts.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
A good line and length, just outside off, pushed to the off side.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and around off, swinging in, pushed straight to mid on. That was sweetly timed.

A better ball to finish. Full and angling away, but closer to the off stump, pushed through the covers where Dane van Niekerk dives to her left and fumbles, parrying it to point. They think about the single but decide against it eventually.
Full and wide outside off, lesser than the previous one, watchfully left alone.

FOUR! HANDSOME! Similar to the previous ball but a bit of extra width on this occasion. The length was full and Knight leaned into one and drove it between point and backward point for a boundary. Pure timing and placement. Daniels needs to be a bit careful with the line given that she does not have too much pace.
Full and wide outside off, swinging away from the batter, Knight looks to drive but misses.
Outside off, pretty wide, driven through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
HEATHER KNIGHT walks out to bat. England need 158 runs off 222 balls with 8 wickets in hand. The skipper just needs to stay composed.

OUT! BOWLED! The birthday girl strikes again! That is what happens when you persist with bowling straight. When the batsman misses, you get a chance to hit. And Khaka does not miss. It was an ugly swipe across the line from Beaumont and she paid the price. All of a sudden, England have fairly two new batters in the middle. The tournament's leading run getter falls cheaply today.
Outside off, eased through the covers for a run.

Good running. It was hit very hard to the fielder and Ismail is not a bad one. Full on middle, Beaumont whips it down the ground and by the time Shabnim Ismail can get to it from mid on, steals a single. 159 more needed from 224 balls now.
Very straight, on a length, just outside off, watchfully blocked.
Outside off, defended towards cover.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short cover.
Trisha Chetty is back with the gloves on!
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside of, driven on the up straight to short extra cover.
Full and outside off, angling away, ST looks to drive but misses.
Pushes this straight to mid on.

Full on middle, Sarah flicks it past a diving Shabnim Ismail at short mid-wicket. It seems like the ball will reach the boundary but Ismail is such a good athlete that she gets up in a flash and herself reaches the ball before it touches the ropes. Two runs taken.
Very full outside off, Taylor looks to squeeze it down to third man but misses.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.

DIRECT HIT WOULD HAVE HAD BEAUMONT! South Africa need to take their opportunities. A length ball outside off, Taylor pushes it through the covers and sets off for a single. Marizanne Kapp comes around quickly and Beaumont would have been gone for all money had Kapp scored with the direct hit at the striker's end. Replays show that even if Kapp had thrown it to the keeper, Beaumont's dive would not have saved her.

FOUR! Edged away! That was almost similar to the way Taylor got out in the previous match. A short ball outside off, Taylor looks to run it down to third man but gets an outside edge which flies past the keeper to the third man fence.
Takes the pace off this one, outside off, pushed straight to point.
Outside off, pushed towards cover.
Full and just on off, pushed towards mid on.

End of the Mandatory Powerplay. South Africa now have taken the maximum wickets in the Mandatory Powerplay in this tournament. Though they won't be happy with this record as so far England look pretty much at ease.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Slanting away from Beaumont, she creams it through the smallest of gaps between point and backward point. Her excellent placement gets her a deserved result in boundary.
On a length on middle and leg, Tammy stays in the crease and defends it with the angle on the off side.
Beaumont defends it off the front foot to covers.
Full outside off, driven with the angle to mid off.
This time Tammy stays in the crease and defends it in the cover region.
Wide! Seeing Beaumont advancing, Daniels bangs in a bouncer down the leg side. Surprises everyone and Tammy lets it sail over. Wide is signalled for height.
Slanting away from the batsman, Beaumont leaves it alone.
MOSELINE DANIELS comes on.
Full and well outside off, left alone. Not a bad start from Khaka - 6 runs but that wicket of Winfield as well.
FOUR! GLORIOUS! Half volley outside off, Taylor eases into this one and drives the ball gloriously through the covers! What a way to get off the mark.
Full and outside off, squeezed down to third man for a single.
SARAH TAYLOR walks out at no.3!

OUT! There comes the breakthrough! Khaka does it for her captain on her birthday. A short ball outside off, Winfield immediately dances down and looks to pull but is taken aback by the extra bounce. The result is a top edge which goes straight up in the air and Mignon du Preez takes it running in from point. The previous over was a maiden from Kapp and the pressure was building on Winfield. She faced 43 balls in a stand which was 51 balls old but was mostly playing and missing. ENGLAND NEED 177 FROM 249 BALLS.
A bit of tidying up done on the seam. Some part of the leather had come off. The umpire cuts it off with a scissor.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
On a good length outside off, Beaumont feels for it but is squared up. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man and they take a single.
AYABONGA KHAKA into the attack now as South Africa make their first change. She bowls medium fast...
Pitched full outside off, pushed to covers. Finally South Africa pull things back a touch as Kapp bowls a MAIDEN!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full outside off, Winfield dances down and drills it but finds the fielder at covers.
On a fuller length outside off, Winfield stays in the crease and defends it watchfully.
The batsman drives this to covers.
Full outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Interesting. SOUTH AFRICA ARE CHANGING THEIR KEEPER. Lizelle Lee takes the gloves off from Trisha Chetty.  Is that on performance or an injury? Your guess is as good as ours...
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. 13 runs from it!
Interestingly, that boundary was also a no ball. But the umpire failed to notice it.

FOUR! Beaumont makes full use of the Free Hit. Ismail bowls another short delivery, angling in. Tammy stays back and pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary. She wont's miss out on such a looseners.
Back-to-back FREE HITS! Not a great display.

Another No ball! Ismail bangs it short and as it's a Free Hit, Winfield goes after it with a heave. Gets a top edge and the ball falls safely in the square leg region. A single results. And guess what? Ismail has overstepped again.
No ball! Full outside off, pushed to mid off. No ball signalled for overstepping. FREE HIT coming up!

ALMOST CHOPPED ON! Back of a length delivery outside off, Beaumont gets on her toes and looks to play it on the off side. Gets an inside edge and the ball goes from over the stumps and runs down to fine leg for a single.
Full outside off, Winfield prods forward to play with soft hands. Gets an outside edge to third man for a single.

FOUR! HAMMERED! Back of a length delivery around off, sits up nicely for Winfield. She latches onto it in a flash and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. England are cruising through at the moment.
Length delivery outside off, Winfield makes a watchful leave.
Pitched wide outside off, guided off the outer half again past backward point. Another single results.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
Angling into the batsman, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Beaumont stays in the crease and defends it watchfully.
Full outside off, Winfield prods forward and steers it off the outer half past backward point for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Wide outside off, guided off the outer half to third man for a single.
Another play and miss from Lauren Winfield. She needs to compose herself here.
Length delivery outside off, Winfield looking to get after the bowler, goes for the drive but is beaten again.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! PULLED AWAY! Banged in short, angling in. Winfield gets into the position early and pulls with disdain through mid-wicket for a boundary. That will boost her confidence!
Back of a length delivery outside off, run down to third man for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.

Five Wides! Poor from Chetty! She is having a horror time in the middle. She has dropped one already and this is her third fumble. Kapp once again sprays it down the leg side. Winfield looks to clip it but misses. Trisha lets it go through under her gloves and concedes five wides.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
Length delivery outside off, swinging away again. Lauren looks to punch it on the up but is beaten again.

DROPPED! A difficult chance though! Fullish delivery outside off, swinging away appreciably. Winfield nicks it on her drive. Chetty the keeper dives full stretch to her right, gets a glove to it but fails to hold onto it. The ball runs through and Wolvaardt in the third man region does well to prevent a boundary. A brace is taken.
Full outside off, driven to covers.
Full outside off, shaping in this time. Winfield goes for the drive but gets beaten again.

Two Wides! Kapp gets her line wrong. Sprays it down the leg side. Beaumont fails to flick it away and Chetty behind the stumps fumbles again. The batsmen run through and the umpire signals a wide as well.
Outswinger on a fuller length outside off, defended off the outer half to point.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fullish outside off, driven to mid off.
Poor shot! Length delivery outside off, Winfield doesn't move her feet and gets beaten on her cut.

Four Byes! UNLUCKY! Peach of a delivery, this! Bowls it on a length and nips back in sharply. Winfield is totally surprised by that and gets beaten on the inside edge. Even Chetty can't stop it cleanly with a dive to her left and the ball races to the fence.
Slightly fuller around off, defended to point.
Pitched wide outside off, Beaumont prods forward and makes a stylish leave.
Length delivery outside off, tapped in the point region for a single.
Ohhh... almost! A touch ahead of a length around off. Winfield looks to push it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On a length outside off, swinging away, left alone.
Angling into the pads, worked through backward square leg for a single.
On a fuller length outside off, Beaumont facing her first delivery leans ahead and places it to point.
MARIZANNE KAPP to share the new ball. She's the number-one ranked ODI bowler. Can she make some early inroads?
Back of a length delivery outside off, defended neatly on the off side.
This time Ismail angles it in from a length outside off. Winfield is watchful and blocks it from within the crease.
Slightly fuller this time, moving away, pushed to covers.
On a length outside off, defended solidly off the front foot on the off side.
FOUR! PIERCED! Full outswinger outside off, driven crisply through covers by Winfield. Gets it past the infield and gets off the mark with a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, shaping away a touch, dabbed to covers.

The players are out in the middle. England need 219 to reach the finals of ICC Women's World Cup, 2017. TAMMY BEAUMONT and LAUREN WINFIELD will open for them. South Africa would be feeling the heat but would be hoping for something special from their bowlers. SHABNIM ISMAIL to operate with the new ball. A wide slip in place. Here we go...
